Stats.title: Progress
Stats.subtitle: Your learning outcomes across all decks.
Stats.diagnosticsRetentionHint: Among reviews of cards you had already learned, the share you recalled correctly by their scheduled date. Higher means memory is holding as planned.
Stats.diagnosticsSuccessHint: Share of swipes you rated a success. A rough gauge of how confident your answers felt.
Stats.diagnosticsLapseHint: Among already-learned cards, the share you forgot on review. Lower means they're sticking.
Stats.diagnosticsStreakHint: Days you've studied without a gap, up to today, calculated from the last 365 days regardless of the selected period. Missing a day resets it.
Stats.diagnosticsReviewsHint: Your total swipes over the last {days} days.
Stats.diagnosticsAvgDifficultyHint: Average "hardness" FSRS assigns your cards (0–10; higher is harder).
Stats.strugglingEmptyBody: You have no repeatedly-forgotten cards. Cards you lapse on will appear here so you can focus your reviews.
Stats.emptyNewUserBody: Pick a ready-made deck from the catalog or create your own, then study a few cards — your mastery, per-deck progress, and diagnostics will appear here.
Stats.emptyNotStudiedBody: Study a few cards and your mastery breakdown and diagnostic metrics will appear here.
Stats.emptyDeck: Your deck has no cards yet
Stats.emptyDeckBody: You created a deck but it has no cards. Add a few cards, then study them — your mastery and progress will appear here.
Stats.diagnosticsNoActivityInWindow: No reviews in the last {days} days.
